data.name: Highlights of Boston and Cambridge
data.headline: For all ages! • 3 & 7 hour options • Starting at $600
data.description:
# Book your luxury tour today!

## Duration & Rates
- **3 Hours** $600
- **7 Hours** $1200

## About
Available in English, Spanish, Italian, Chinese, and Turkish.

Fully customizable. 

Chauffeured driving and walking included.

Get to know the highlights of Boston and Cambridge in a half-a-day or dive deeper in a full-day tour. As you travel back in time, you’ll learn that the Boston/Cambridge area has many firsts - The Boston Public Garden, Boston Common, First School Site, Harvard University, and Fenway Park for Major League Baseball.

Travel along The Freedom Trail to learn about the American Revolution. Visit Faneuil Hall, a large indoor market and a meeting place during the war. See Paul Revere House, the Old North Church, and the Bunker Hill Monument, all must-see sites for history lovers. Discover attractions not seen by most tourists like the Church of the Covenant, a house of worship that has stunning stained-glass windows made by Tiffany. 

Or visit the North End, home to Little Italy with numerous Italian restaurants, pastry shops, and delis. This area has some of the oldest buildings in the city. Newbury Street is a bustling district filled with19th-century brownstones that house restaurants, retail stores, and a vibrant entertainment district for a fun night-on-the-town.

The architecture of Copley Square is also a popular tourist site. The styles in this square range from the Gothic Revival of the Old South Church to the modern Hancock Tower, a glass skyscraper office building. 

Experience the highlights of Boston and Cambridge in this fascinating half- or full-day tour.
